about_the_game:
Your home is no longer a safe place. "Mom? Dad?" Little Lawrence wakes up alone in the middle of the night, but the house isn't empty. Grotesque figures straight out of a nightmare lurk in the hallways, turning his warm home into a place where he's no longer safe.

A classic survival horror game where stealth is your only defense.

STAY HIDDEN. SURVIVE.

You are defenseless. You can't fight back. Your only option is to run and hide. Use closets, boxes, and every nook and cranny to stay out of sight of the creatures hunting you. Direct confrontation is deadly. But be careful: once hidden, Lawrence will panic, and you must help him calm down. If you fail, you will be discovered.

Uncover the secrets of a home you no longer recognize. Solve the puzzles blocking your path and find keys to unlock new rooms.

VISUAL STYLE:

A haunting, gothic art style inspired by the works of Tim Burton.

Hand-painted 2D cinematics for jump scares, death sequences, and narrative moments. Inspired by the aesthetic of the analog horror series The Walten Files.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes scenes that hint at blood and violence throughout the story, both in the cinematic scenes and in the gameplay.
